old_caption: The video captures a sky scene with dynamic cloud movement over a landscape with trees and power lines. Initially, thick, dark clouds dominate, creating a dramatic atmosphere. As the video progresses, these clouds disperse, revealing patches of sky and allowing sunlight to filter through. The trees, silhouetted against the changing sky, sway gently. The power lines remain static across the frame. The overall mood shifts from brooding to peaceful as the clouds clear and the sun shines more brightly.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene sky scene, showcasing the dynamic movement of clouds over a landscape dotted with trees and power lines. Initially, the sky is filled with thick, dark clouds, creating a dramatic and somewhat ominous atmosphere. As the video progresses, these clouds begin to disperse, revealing patches of blue sky and allowing sunlight to filter through, casting a warm glow across the scene. The trees, silhouetted against the changing sky, sway gently in the breeze, adding a sense of tranquility. The power lines stretch across the frame, providing a stark contrast to the natural elements below. The overall mood shifts from tense and brooding to peaceful and hopeful as the clouds clear and the sun begins to shine more brightly.
caption: The video captures a stationary outdoor view of a cloudy sky framed by foreground silhouettes, with power lines crossing the upper-middle and dark trees lining the bottom. A heavy dark gray cloud deck already hangs overhead, above a brighter ragged band and a pale glow near the right horizon. Over time, that deck thins and retreats toward the top edge, shifting the upper sky from solid overcast to a textured layer. The middle band continuously deforms rather than sliding, puffy white-and-gray masses growing, merging and rearranging while a bright vertical column in the center appears and later dissipates. Patches of pale blue sky open toward the upper corners as the scene brightens, while the right-horizon glow and cloud undersides persist. The power lines and tree silhouettes stay in place throughout.

This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.
The first view may already be mid-action; the last view need not contain completion. Different
endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.

'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.
